status: No remaining blocker found within this patch after narrow repairs; not a language-quality or production-readiness approval.

resolved_findings.finding: A content change observed by the final response view could still commit a turn.
resolved_findings.evidence: The new deterministic test changed the server library during matching; before repair the endpoint returned 200 with current=false and mutated the mission.
resolved_findings.fix: Before save/commit, turn/clarify/reset reject a final stale view with exercise_updated; transaction rollback preserves the exact stored payload.

resolved_findings.finding: Clarification wrapped exercise_updated as a generic 409 and lost the stale-session status.
resolved_findings.fix: Preserve structured exercise_updated errors so the UI marks the history stale and offers the separate updated task.
resolved_findings.test: stale-session.test.cjs: clarification race retains draft and hides Send

resolved_findings.finding: Starting the updated task retained the cached old mission for follow-up activities.
resolved_findings.fix: Use the returned session snapshot mission for state.mission.
resolved_findings.test: stale-session.test.cjs: old cached library plus new server snapshot uses updated follow-up content

resolved_findings.finding: Deleting an active task cleared the saved draft map but retained active draft and voice buffers.
resolved_findings.fix: Clear active draft, original transcript, pending audio and support on active-task/all-practice deletion.
resolved_findings.test: stale-session.test.cjs: individual and bulk deletion clear buffers and map

resolved_findings.finding: A cached completion response marked stale could still open the normal completion page.
resolved_findings.fix: Stale send/clarify responses open the historical practice view before testing completion status.
resolved_findings.test: stale-session.test.cjs: cached completed retry shows update notice

verified_properties: Full canonical mission content is compared, not only library version; client-supplied snapshot/status fields cannot override the server snapshot.
Owner lookup and existing authentication/CSRF checks precede mutation; cached same-payload retries preserve prior results and attach current stale status without replaying mutation.
Stale turn/clarify/reset requests retain history, labels, completion evidence and selection. New updated sessions preserve prior SFI selection without transferring the old task draft.
Stale semantic requests reject before inference and budget admission; post-inference guards reject a changed library. Tests use mocked inference only.
Drafts are memory-only and session-scoped; account changes invalidate delayed starts, while deletion/signout clear applicable buffers. Copy explicitly states reload loss.

test_evidence.result: 44 tests: 43 passed, 1 optional real-audio test skipped;110.803 seconds. Includes historical, library-change, isolation/CSRF, reset/delete and idempotency coverage.
All 10 frontend suites passed, including expanded stale-session regression.

limits: Library-change tests deterministically replace the library returned by the loader; they do not claim atomic synchronization between arbitrary filesystem writes and SQLite commits. Production must retain the existing immutable source/image discipline.
No hidden acceptance texts read, native models run, builds performed or deployment changed. Native language acceptance remains unqualified and separate.
This report preserves earlier security reports and does not approve unrestricted conversation or learner efficacy.
